subject: Offer approval request: outlier sign-on + structured equity refresh for Alexandra Nguyen
messages:
From: TalentWorks Recruiting <hiring@talentworks.co>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Alexandra Nguyen – offer packet + counteroffer summary

Hi Jasmine / Laura,

Thanks for taking this through — Alexandra Nguyen (linked candidate) just shared a competitive counteroffer from another employer. She remains excited about Redwood but asked us to escalate the request for an enhanced sign-on and an equity refresh to match the competing package.

Attached: candidate_resume.pdf; counteroffer_summary.pdf (high-level comparison).

Quick summary:
- Role: Senior Inference Engineer (IC-4) – team: Serving Runtime
- Candidate asking: $40,000 sign-on OR equivalent equity refresh + $20k in base uplift (they prefer sign-on + equity)
- Timing: candidate expects decision by Thu 11 Mar to avoid accepting competitor

Can you advise whether Redwood can consider an exception to the standard sign-on band? If so, what approval path do we need to follow and which stakeholders must sign off today?

Recruiter (TalentWorks) will coordinate if you want us to present a formal LOI.

Best,
Maya Huang
TalentWorks Recruiting
[Attachment: candidate_resume.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: counteroffer_summary.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Alexandra Nguyen – offer packet + counteroffer summary

Thanks Maya — looping in Ben and Monica for approvals and Laura for comp ops.

Recommendation (short): propose a middle-ground "structured signing safeguard": a $30k sign-on plus a one-time equity refresh of 0.15% (additional RSU grant), with a 12-month retention clawback clause if voluntary departure < 12 months. Rationale:
- Candidate brings rare LLM runtime expertise (KV cache + quantization) and has multiple offers.
- Role will own a 3-month critical rollout (low-latency ingest pipeline) — high-risk to lose candidate.
- Standard sign-on band for IC-4 is $10–15k; the request is outlier territory.

I attached an outlier-proposal.pdf with bulletized impact analysis and a proposed vesting/forfeiture schedule. If we can lock on $30k + 0.15% equity, I think we minimize runway risk and preserve budget vs larger base uplift.

Ask: Ben / Monica — can you weigh in with finance/sales perspective? Laura — can you start the comp-exception form if we have preliminary approval? I can coordinate docuSign and candidate comms.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Sr. Recruiter, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: outlier-proposal.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Alexandra Nguyen – offer packet + counteroffer summary

Agree with Jasmine's middle-ground approach. Sales impact perspective: losing this hire delays a planned inference performance pilot for a marquee customer (Q3), which could push revenue recognition and increase support load on existing team. Approving a partial exception now is preferable to derailing the pilot.

Proposed quick decision: APPROVE up to $30k sign-on + 0.15% equity refresh, conditional on People Ops and Finance signing the comp-exception form and finalizing clawback language. If Finance pushes back, allow manager-authorized discretionary top-up up to $5k out of team recruiting budget.

Next steps I can take: escalate to Markus for Finance nod and prepare a short memo to CTO explaining revenue risk. Please CC me on candidate comms.

Ben
Head of Sales Strategy, Redwood Inference

On Tue, Mar 9, 2027 at 09:05 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Alexandra Nguyen – offer packet + counteroffer summary

Thanks — appreciate the context.

I started the comp-exception worksheet (attached) and flagged the following items we need before final sign-off:
- Business justification memo (Jasmine/Ben) documenting product impact and risk 
- Funding source (Markus): confirm whether cost is charged to Recruiting discretionary pool or to Product (team) OPEX
- Final clawback language (legal) — I recommend a 12-month prorated clawback tied to forfeiture of the equity refresh if voluntary departure < 12 months; sign-on to be repaid on a pro rata basis over 12 months (standard).

Markus — can you confirm funding availability for a $30k top-up + 0.15% equity by EOD? If you need a tighter figure, propose $25k + 0.15% as fallback.

Candidate timeline constraint noted (decision by Thu 11 Mar). If Finance confirms, we'll prepare final offer PDF and route via DocuSign.

Laura Bennett
Head of Total Rewards, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: comp-exception-form.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Nguyen <alexandra.nguyen@gmail.com>, Maya Huang <hiring@talentworks.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Final approval: Offer (approved exception) — Alexandra Nguyen

Hi Alexandra / Maya — happy to confirm: Redwood is approving an exception for Alexandra Nguyen's offer. Summary of the approved package below and next steps.

Approved package:
- Base salary: unchanged from original offer
- Signing bonus: $30,000 (one-time, taxable)
- Equity: one-time refresh of 0.15% RSUs (time-vested with standard 4-year schedule; additional performance tranche — 0.05% — vests on delivery of the Q3 inference rollout objective, discretionary)
- Clawback / repayment: 12-month prorated repayment schedule for sign-on and forfeiture rules for equity refresh as documented in the comp-exception form

Conditions: final offer PDF will include the exact clawback wording and manager sign-off. We will route the package via DocuSign once Markus confirms funding allocation (Finance).

Next steps (owner):
- Markus (Finance) confirm funding allocation and sign the comp-exception form (by EOD Thu 11 Mar)
- Laura finalize comp-exception form + legal clawback language and attach to final_offer_alex_nguyen.pdf
- Jasmine coordinate DocuSign envelope and candidate comms; TalentWorks to deliver acceptance once doc signed

Attachments: final_offer_alex_nguyen.pdf (draft) — please review. DocuSign link will be sent after Finance signs off.

Alexandra, please let us know if you need any clarification — we aim to get this wrapped before Thu evening.

Thanks everyone for the quick turn.

Jasmine Liu
Senior Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: final_offer_alex_nguyen.pdf (pdf)]
